summary: Iteration 12: Full testing of Skin Collection Showcase feature. Fixed critical routing bug in backend (route order). All 20 backend tests PASS. All frontend features verified working.

critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: Route order in showcase.py - specific routes must come before wildcard /{wallet_address}
Code quality: showcase.py properly excludes _id from MongoDB queries
Code quality: Stats calculation correctly handles missing ethereal requirement
Frontend: data-testid attributes properly applied to skin cards for testing
seed_data_creation: No seed data needed - tests use unique TEST_ prefixed wallet addresses. Used existing TEST_giftflow_recipient_ebb244d0 wallet for gift skin verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 12 verified Showcase feature: Backend has 5 endpoints - GET /api/showcase/{wallet} (returns collection with stats), GET /api/showcase/leaderboard/collectors (ranked collectors), GET /api/showcase/recent-acquisitions (recent skin purchases), POST /api/showcase/settings (update display name/bio), POST /api/showcase/share/{wallet} (generate share link). Frontend routes: /showcase (no wallet - connect prompt), /showcase/:walletAddress (full collection view). Game page has Award icon button (data-testid='showcase-btn') linking to showcase. IMPORTANT: Route order in FastAPI matters - specific routes before wildcards.
